info.title: Neon conversation and key allowance API
info.description: Scoped description of conversation metadata, archive browsing, permanent deletion, message image inputs, reasoning effort and key allowance endpoints. Other Neon routes are documented in README.md.

get.summary: Read the current workspace API key spending allowance
get.description: Amounts are USD key-limit amounts, not account credits. No provider key returns configured=false and null amounts without an upstream request. A null limit means no key limit.

delete.description: Deletes active or archived conversation history, jobs and notification rows. Aborts running generation. Retains only the conversation ID and workspace ID to reject stale creation retries. Repeated deletion of the same workspace-owned ID succeeds. Database backups and already delivered notifications are not erased.

get.description: conversationMetadata=true enables Pin and Rename. Older backends omit this field; clients treat omission as unsupported. reasoningEffort=true enables optional per-message reasoning effort. Older backends omit it; clients must omit the request field when unsupported. conversationDeletion=true enables permanent deletion; older backends omit it and clients keep deletion unavailable for synced conversations.

post.description: Idempotently clears archived and increments revision once only on a change. Returns the canonical snapshot with jobs. Preserves title, pin, pause state, job IDs, statuses and text. Does not enqueue, resume, call a provider or create notifications.

get.summary: Stream job deltas and status with full response metadata
get.description: SSE status events carry the JSON schema in x-status-event-schema and are emitted initially, on status or metadata changes, and before terminal close. Reconnect receives current full metadata even if no text delta remains. Delta event IDs remain UTF-16 content offsets; metadata events do not advance the cursor.

post.summary: Durably accept text and optional inline images
post.description: Omission preserves provider defaults. Retry the same job ID and immutable thread, prompt, model and effort; conflicting retries return 409. Explicit none differs from omission. Queues and restarts retain the captured effort. Forks inherit the original target effort. This capability does not guarantee every provider supports every effort. Optional images preserves attachment order. Omission equals [] for retries. A prompt may be empty when images are attached. This route accepts a maximum 12 MiB JSON body. Provider history is limited to 16 MiB decoded image data and fails explicitly without a provider call if exceeded; attachments are never silently dropped. Send images only when capabilities advertise imageInputs:true.

images.description: Inline PNG/JPEG base64 data URLs only, at most 2 MiB decoded per image. Canonical strict base64 and matching image signatures are validated; remote URLs are rejected.

post.summary: Fork a conversation while preserving prior images
post.description: The original conversation remains unchanged. Prior completed or partial turns retain their images. The edited turn inherits target images when images is omitted; explicit [] removes them and a nonempty array replaces them. Empty prompt requires resulting images. Maximum JSON body is 12 MiB. An existing branch or job ID returns 409; fetch the deterministic branch and compare the immutable prompt and images before considering retry recovery successful.
